description: Source code implementing ASN.1 encoding/decoding and key management functions for X25519 elliptic curve cryptography within OpenSSL, including functions for setting, getting, encoding, decoding, and comparing keys.

methods.name: x25519_free
methods.description: Frees the EVP_PKEY's internal key structure.

methods.name: x25519_set_priv_raw
methods.description: Sets a private key from raw bytes.

methods.name: x25519_set_pub_raw
methods.description: Sets a public key from raw bytes.

methods.name: x25519_get_priv_raw
methods.description: Retrieves the private key in raw form.

methods.name: x25519_get_pub_raw
methods.description: Retrieves the public key in raw form.

methods.name: x25519_set1_tls_encodedpoint
methods.description: Sets public key from TLS encoded point.

methods.name: x25519_get1_tls_encodedpoint
methods.description: Gets TLS encoded public key point.

methods.name: x25519_pub_decode
methods.description: Decodes a public key from ASN.1 parameters and key.

methods.name: x25519_pub_encode
methods.description: Encodes a public key into ASN.1 format.

methods.name: x25519_priv_decode
methods.description: Decodes a private key from ASN.1 format.

methods.name: x25519_priv_encode
methods.description: Encodes a private key into ASN.1 format.

methods.name: x25519_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the key in bytes.

methods.name: x25519_bits
methods.description: Returns the size of the key in bits.
